subject: Fix duplicate Acks for RDMA events and fix extremely large max latency for RDMA benchmark. (#2430)
reason: The change is confined to RDMA-only code: src/rdma.c is compiled only under USE_RDMA, the valkey-benchmark changes are inside #ifdef USE_RDMA / config.ct == VALKEY_CONN_RDMA guards (the TCP branch of createClient is behaviorally unchanged), and tests/rdma/rdma-test.c is an RDMA test harness. Reaching the changed paths requires an RDMA transport (RDMA NIC or root-configured soft-RoCE) and RDMA-enabled builds and clients, none of which the fuzzer's TCP-only local deployments or installed components provide. Any scenario over TCP would exercise identical code on both builds and could not observe
